title: Interior Grid Formats: Leaflets & Folders
slide_intent: Teach designers to coordinate a sequence of narrow pages. A stable track for pictures and captions lets a reader follow changes across a folded publication.
strategic_value: NASA can vary a leaflet’s rhythm while retaining the order that makes a small publication easy to use.
demonstration: Three rows show alternative one-column systems. Captions occupy a bottom margin in a, photographs run along a lower track in b, and full-bleed images alternate with lower-half text in c.
practical_value: Choose a grid by the amount of image and caption material. Test consecutive pages together so each repeated track carries the intended content.

content_islands.name: Three grid descriptions
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and the three lettered descriptions in the upper columns.

content_islands.name: Bottom caption margin
content_islands.spec: Diagram option a with headings at the top, substantial text or image fields and captions across the lower margin.

content_islands.name: Lower photo track
content_islands.spec: Diagram option b with heads and text aligned at the top and pictures on a lower track with captions above.

content_islands.name: Full-bleed image pages
content_islands.spec: Diagram option c with alternating full-height image pages and text confined to the lower half of the adjoining pages. Retain red guides through the sequence.
